description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [HP Stock (6000)], [Haste], [Protect], [Shell], and [Last Stand] to all allies, grants [100% Critical (25s)] to all allies if Clive is in the party, causes [Imperil Ice 20% (15s)] to all enemies if Jill is in the party, causes [Imperil Fire 20% (15s)] to all enemies if Joshua is in the party, causes [Imperil Lightning 20% (15s)] to all enemies if Cidolfus is in the party, grants Awoken Frost Wolf Mode and [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user
Awoken Frost Wolf Mode: Unlimited Support/Celerity/Black Magic Hones, Support/Celerity/Black Magic Rank Quick Cast & chases Support/Celerity/Black Magic abilities with Quick Cast 1 to all allies
